How Red Planet WorksRed PlanetAtlasLandAtlasCREAtlasPropAtlasTrade
§ 01

What Red Planet Data is.

Red Planet Data brings counties online and licenses the county record through Atlas, its platform. Four views read that record; AtlasLand and AtlasCRE first.

§ 02

Every county, looked at.

The County Catalog profiles and scores every county, so a license can begin anywhere.

§ 03

What a license includes.

A license names counties and seats. Everything that applies to those counties comes with it.

  • The county record

    Every record Atlas holds for the county: boards and meetings, land and owners, infrastructure and growth.

  • Every view that applies

    AtlasLand, AtlasCRE, AtlasProp and AtlasTrade, each where it applies to the county, at no extra charge.

  • Seats

    In blocks of 10 for an organization, or one seat for an individual; each seat is a company email.

§ 04

Intake.

Every county goes through the same five steps, so almost any county is online in days to weeks. Then price, sign and go live.

  1. 1

    Map the county

    Every board that decides land, in the county and its towns.

  2. 2

    Collect the record

    Several years of agendas, packets and minutes, plus the land records.

  3. 3

    Read it into cases

    Each value tied to its document and page.

  4. 4

    Add what is coming

    Road funding, capacity decisions, annexations, fee studies, rule changes.

  5. 5

    State the coverage

    Which boards are in, from when, and what is not available.

  1. then 1

    Price

    Atlas prices the license by county and seats; the same price built or not.

  2. then 2

    Sign

    Twelve months, paid in advance, with Red Planet Data, Inc.

  3. then 3

    Go live

    Access opens in days to weeks; the first 30 days of a new county are included in full.

§ 05

Terms.

One seat or hundreds, every agreement follows the same four rules.

Ownership

Red Planet Data owns all data

Customers license the data, never own it. Every agreement is signed with Red Planet Data, Inc.

Term

12-month minimum, paid up front

The license renews each year, and customers can add counties or seats at any time.

Seats

One company email per seat

Seats can be shared or charged for inside the organization, but never resold outside it.

Coverage

Almost any county, online in days to weeks

Every county is priced the same way, built or not.
